description: Turn a category's carryover on or off from a month onwards, so overspending rolls into that category next month instead of coming off the money to assign. Actual writes the flag into every month from the one given to the last the budget has, not only that one.

enabled.description: true to carry overspending forward in this category, false to stop

month.description: Month this starts from, and every month after it in the budget is set too (YYYY-MM or natural language). Defaults to this month.

name: set_category_carryover
